// classic two-tone); ShadeColor is the darkened band color; RimColor is added
// at grazing angles with a RimPower falloff exponent; OutlineWidth is in
// pixels (0 = no outline). (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cel_shading)
type ToonMaterial
    implements IValue
{
    BaseColor: Color;
    ShadeColor: Color;
